title: NIST ASD: sodium D lines at 588.995095 nm and 589.592424 nm in air
summary: The NIST ASD retrieval for Na I lists observed air wavelengths 588.995095 nm and 589.592424 nm, each with uncertainty 0.000003 nm.
body: The NIST Atomic Spectra Database retrieval for Na between 580 and 600 nm lists two Na I lines. Observed air wavelength 588.995095 nm, uncertainty 0.000003 nm, from 3s 2S 1/2 to 3p 2P* 3/2, relative intensity 80000, Einstein A 6.16 × 10^7 s^−1, accuracy AA. Observed air wavelength 589.592424 nm, uncertainty 0.000003 nm, from 3s 2S 1/2 to 3p 2P* 1/2, relative intensity 40000, Einstein A 6.14 × 10^7 s^−1, accuracy AA. The wavelength column is labeled observed, in air. The Einstein A column is a transition probability, not the wavelength measurement.
